title: Customer Operations Lead
description:
About Hercules

Hercules (hercules.app) is an AI app builder - like Lovable, Replit, or Base44. We have 300k+ users and receive ~250 support tickets a day, and that number is growing fast.
About the role
We're looking for a Customer Operations Lead to run our support team. You'll own the customer support experience end to end, and build the AI automations that let a small team handle a huge and growing ticket volume.
What you'll do

• Resolve tier 1 tickets (general platform Q&A)

• Resolve tier 2 tickets (billing and admin operations)

• Manage engineers to resolve tier 3 tickets

• Maintain our knowledge bases

• Build and maintain AI automations to automatically resolve tickets at 10x scale

• Build and maintain AI automations that summarize voice of customer and product feedback for the whole company

What we're looking for

• Excellent communication (we have a very high bar)

• Able to close ~150 tickets per day (with heavy AI help)

• Prior experience in a customer support role

• Experience building and maintaining knowledge bases and SOPs

• Extensive Stripe experience (refunds, chargebacks, credit notes)

• Experience building AI automations

• Experience managing a support team

• Able to work one weekend a month

Nice to have

• Some coding experience (or vibe coding)

• Very fast typist (or uses an AI dictation tool like Wispr Flow)

What are Hercules ' operating principles?
Hercules ' operating principles guide how we make decisions every day. We take them very seriously. Most of them are choices that we as a company uniquely prioritize, and so can be learned on the job. However, we do specifically filter for these principles in our hiring process:

• We move with urgency. We ship fast, iterate, and correct mistakes quickly. Our bias for action speeds our learning and delights our customers.

• We strive for excellence. Doing things well is in our DNA. We have good taste. We get the details right. Our outputs are exceptionally simple and self-serve. We're proud of our work.

• We are hungry. We are willing to work hard and break through walls to achieve the outcomes we want. We are willing to operate at any level to get things done. We are politely relentless.

Is Hercules in-office or remote?
Hercules ' founding team works in-office in San Francisco (Kearny and Bush). We have a very strong preference for in office. We are open to remote for exceptional candidates in US time zones who would be willing/able to travel to the office regularly.
What are Hercules ' benefits?

• Healthcare, vision, and dental

• Use whatever AI productivity tools you'd like

• Take what you need vacation policy

• Daily lunches, dinners, and snacks in the office

• We guarantee you will do the best work of your career here

What's the compensation?
$100k-$250k + equity (depends on seniority, experience, and location)

Opportunity

This is a full-time, exempt Telehealth Transitional Care Nurse Practitioner role focused on post-discharge care. You’ll work remotely with members and caregivers through virtual visits, helping close care gaps, support safe recovery, and escalate urgent clinical concerns when needed.

Role details:

•
Employment type: Full-time, exempt

•
Work model: Remote / telehealth

•
Schedule: Core hours of 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM Central Time, Monday through Friday

•

Start: ASAP

Transitional Care Management Visits

• Conduct telehealth TCM visits within the required post-discharge window.

• Transitional Care Management or post-discharge care experience.

title: Investor Relations Associate v2
description:
We are hiring an Investor Relations Associate to help grow the investor side of Paires, the network of family offices and high-net-worth individuals our founders raise from.

Paires is where founders come to raise capital. We pair them with the right investors from a large, engaged global investor network, then our agents manage the relationships that turn into meetings. It is a two-sided platform, live with paying clients, profitable and self-funded, built by a small, senior, flat team that ships fast.

The role

The craft of this seat is allocator trust, and we are hiring people early in that craft who are already showing they have it. You will work alongside our senior investor team on live mandates: qualifying allocators, preparing briefs, running follow-ups, and keeping investor relationships warm between deals. And from day one you will build your own: identifying family offices and HNWIs who back US startups, earning first conversations, and growing a book that is yours.

You do not need a decade of relationships. You need the beginnings of a real network, a method for growing it that you can explain, and the discipline to treat other people's capital and privacy with care. The rest, the mandate craft, the briefing standard, the judgment calls, you learn here, working next to people who do this every day. One thing this seat is not: technical. Our engineers build the platform and the agents. You work inside them, so your hours go to investors instead of admin.

What you will own

- Your growing book. The allocator relationships you bring and the ones you open here, qualified and kept warm.

- Mandate support that matters. Investor qualification, briefing notes, and follow-through on live deals, done to the house standard.

- New doors. A monthly rhythm of first conversations with family offices and HNWIs who are new to Paires.

- Your development. Every investor call you shadow and every brief you write compounds into the senior version of this seat.

You are a fit if you

- Have started building an allocator network for real, through a seat in wealth management, private banking, a family office, placement, or your own hustle, and can show relationships you opened yourself.

- Can explain your method. How you find the right investors, how you earn the first conversation, and how you stay useful to them after it.

- Know what your investors actually do with their money, and ideally that includes direct allocations into US startups.

- Listen more than you pitch. Allocators trust you because you never waste their time, and you would rather lose a meeting than force one.

- Treat discretion as a reflex. Names, allocations, and conversations stay confidential, always.

- Work like it's 2026. AI tooling runs your pipeline and prep, so your hours go to people.

What we offer

Fully remote and async. Your day overlaps with US Eastern time for a few hours, not full US hours. Meetings batch on Mondays and Thursdays, the rest is deep work. The best AI tooling, paid. A senior team to learn the craft from, live deal flow from week one, and a seat that grows into managing your own side of the network.

How to apply: hit apply, which takes you to our short application form. We read every application. Do not include investor names anywhere in it. We evaluate composition, not contacts.
